asserts: Confidence decays away from the census anchor and a fresh census resets it. This is the mechanic that lets the system ask for ground truth when it needs it, instead of netting the tank on a calendar.

anchor.method: TBD - census method is an open question in ADR-023

expected.notes_on_expectation: Widths are not asserted as values. What is asserted is the ordering and the reset, because the widening function is configuration and the maximum anchor age is an open question in ADR-023. A case pinning specific widths would be testing the tuning rather than the mechanic.

must_not: publish any evaluation without an interval
keep the interval constant as the anchor ages
narrow the interval without a new census or another confirmed fact
treat the 2026-09-14 census as one estimator among several rather than as the anchor
notes: The census came back 8 below the anchor after 60 days. Whether the system's point estimate tracked that drift is a coverage question measured across many anchors, not something this case asserts. What this case defends is that the system was honest about widening uncertainty in the meantime.
